abstract: BACKGROUND: Gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) is a disease with a course of trophoblastic proliferation, and histologically classified as partial hydatidiform mole, complete mole, invasive and metastatic mole, choriocarcinoma and placental site trophoblastic tumor. Occurrence of GTN in postmenopausal women is rare. CASE: We report the case of a 56-year-old postmenopausal woman with a complete mole. The patient was admitted to gynecology outpatient clinic with abdominal pain, nausea and vomiting for about 1 month. Ultrasound examination revealed enlargement of the uterus with endometrial thickness containing hypo/hyper echogeneous and cystic areas. Serum beta-HCG was tested against the possibility of GTN because of the appearance in sonography and was found >5000. The patient underwent total abdominal hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. The serum level of beta-HCG has decreased from initially observed 188,000-0 U/ml in 4th week. The resected uterus contained an endometrial, cystic, grapelike tumor. Microscopic examination demonstrated hydropic degeneration of all the chorionic villi with trophoblastic cell proliferation consistent with a complete hydatidiform mole. CONCLUSION: To our knowledge, our case is the fourth description in the world literature of a benign complete hydatidiform mole in a postmenopausal woman. Although benign gestational trophoblastic disease generally occurs in women of reproductive age and is extremely rare in postmenopausal women, when evaluating patients who are in postmenopausal period the diagnosis of hydatidiform mole must always be considered.
abstract_ja: 背景：妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍（GTN）は、部分胞状奇胎、完全胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎および転移性奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍を含む、絨毛性増殖を特徴とする疾患である。閉経後女性におけるGTNの発生はまれである。症例：56歳の閉経後女性が、約1か月にわたる腹痛、悪心、嘔吐を主訴に婦人科外来を受診した。超音波検査で子宮の拡大と、低エコー・高エコーおよび嚢胞状の領域を伴う子宮内膜の肥厚を認めた。画像所見からGTNの可能性を考えてβ-hCGを測定したところ、5000を超えた。全腹式子宮摘出術と両側卵管卵巣摘除術を受けた。血清β-hCGは、第4週に観察された188,000 U/mLから0まで低下した。切除された子宮には、内膜に嚢胞性で葡萄状の腫瘍を認めた。顕微鏡検査では、すべての絨毛が水腫性変性を示し、絨毛細胞の増殖を伴っており、完全胞状奇胎に一致した。結論：本症例は、閉経後女性における良性完全胞状奇胎の世界文献上4例目の報告である。良性妊娠性絨毛性疾患は通常生殖年齢の女性に生じ、閉経後女性ではきわめてまれであるが、閉経後の患者を評価する際には、胞状奇胎の診断を必ず考慮すべきである。
